We strive to make the repair process as hassle-free as possible, so that you, our customers, can get back on the road safely and with confidence. Our team of trained, skilled technicians is dedicated to delivering outstanding workmanship and unparalleled customer satisfaction. | Services | List of Services | FREE ESTIMATES Evaluating your vehicle's damage to provide a cost projection for repairs, without any obligation or initial charge. | FREE ESTIMATES | INSURANCE ASSISTANCE Guiding you through the insurance claim process, communicating with your provider, and ensuring repairs are correctly documented per your provider’s guidelines. | INSURANCE ASSISTANCE | LIFETIME WARRANTY Lifetime Guarantee that any repair work performed is free of defects and will be fixed at no cost if issues arise, for as long as you own the vehicle. | LIFETIME WARRANTY | ADDITIONAL SERVICES | Need glass replacement? | Glass replacement alone is not a service we provide. We do work in partnership with Auto Glass Center, a trusted local business. If glass replacement or labor is part of your collision repair, we will coordinate the process to keep things simple for you. | Phone number 850-863-0700 | Learn more | Need A Tow? | We do not have our own tow service but, we proudly recommend a family-owned towing company, Holmes Auto Repair. They have been in business since 1959 and are known for fair pricing, honest service, and taking great care of our customers. They will bring your vehicle to us at your request. | Phone number 850-243-2258. | Learn more | Frequently Asked Questions | What services do you offer at your collision repair shop? | We specialize in collision repair and handle the process from start to finish. Our services include body repair, paint and refinishing, frame work, and structural repairs. | While we do not perform glass replacement, paintless dent repair (PDR), or major mechanical work in-house, we coordinate and sublet those services through trusted partners when they are part of the collision repair process—so you still have one point of contact throughout your repair. | Do you work with insurance companies? | Yes, we work with most insurance companies and also accept self-pay repairs . We handle the negotiation with your insurance provider, including estimates, supplements, and repair documentation, to help make the process as smooth as possible. | Please note that the insurance claim must be initiated by the vehicle owner. Once a claim is open, we’re happy to work directly with your insurance company on your behalf throughout the repair process. | How long will it take to repair my vehicle? | Repair timelines vary depending on the extent of damage. Some damage isn’t visible until the vehicle is disassembled at our shop, and additional repairs may be identified at that time. | Once the full scope of repairs is known, the process includes insurance approval (if applicable), parts ordering, repair, paint, reassembly, calibrations, any required sublet services, and a final quality inspection. Because of these variables, it’s difficult to provide an exact completion date upfront. | That said, we keep you informed throughout the process and provide biweekly updates on your vehicle’s status so you’re never left guessing. | How much will it cost to repair my vehicle? | The cost of repairs depends on a variety of factors, including the extent of the damage, the parts and materials needed, and the labor required to complete the repairs. We can schedule you a free visible damage report to give you an idea of the costs involved. Keep in mind disassembly of the damaged area of the car is almost always necessary to obtain an accurate estimate of repairs. | Do you offer a warranty on your repairs? | Yes, we stand behind our work with a warranty on all workmanship for as long as you own the vehicle. Parts will carry the manufacturer’s warranty. If you experience any issues or concerns with your repairs, simply bring your vehicle back and we'll make it right. | Do you do all over paint jobs? | We don’t perform full, all-over paint jobs. Our refinish work is focused specifically on collision repairs when it is necessary to properly repair your vehicle. | WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS SAY ABOUT US | Certified Collision Repairs | --> --> --> --> | Contact Us | We’d love to hear from you. | Send us a message using the form below and we’ll get back to you as soon as we can. | Contact Us | Name: | Email: | Phone: | Comment or Message: | Thank you for contacting us. | We will get back to you as soon as possible. | Oops, there was an error sending your message. | Please try again later. | Apply For Financing | ABOUT | SERVICES | FAQ | REVIEWS | CONTACT | CAREERS | REPAIR AUTHORIZATION | REPAIR STATUS | CONTACT | MIRACLE STRIP BODY SHOP, INC. | 318 RACETRACK ROAD NW, FORT WALTON BEACH, FL 32547, United States | +1 850-862-8212 | james@msbsinc.net | VISIT | Mon - Thu | 7:00 am - 6:00 pm | Fri - Sun | Closed | © 2026 | All Rights Reserved | Share by: | @context | https //schema.org | @type | WebSite | name | MIRACLE STRIP BODY SHOP | INC. | url | https //www.miraclestripbodyshop.com/
